this paper presents a novel and compact device that converts the polarization of light between a solid-core and a hollow-core photonic crystal waveguide, which is a crucial element for the integration of different types of photonic crystal waveguides.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the design of the mode and polarization converter has been completed.
the proposed mode and polarization converter can be a building block for 3D PhC-based optical interconnects.
the device is capable of providing high power conversion efficiency with low loss, low reflection, and infinite polarization extinction ratio.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the design of a compact mode converter in 3D photonics can be optimized based on the mode field distributions of the input and output waveguides.
the mode converter can be realized in 3D SC PhCs with a length of only 25 μm, and thus can be integrated in 3D optical circuits for applications in quantum computing and optical communication.
the mode and polarization conversion in PhC circuits is not limited to the case of a W1 SC waveguide coupled to a W1 HC waveguide.
